summary: Improved Auto Mace Swap, Added Pearl Follow to Pearl Grapple (Grapple, Pearl Follow, Both modes + Follow Only On Key / Follow Key) and overhauled airborne & Elytra Mace PvP prediction (feet-anchored 0.6x0.6x0.6 gliding hitbox, pose-accurate self eye height, vanilla pearl tick physics), Restored classic Auto Anchor (Smart / Classic styles) hardened with ActionCoordinator slot/interact guards, crouch-safe ray checks, and clean packet flushing to prevent flags

changes.title: Improved Auto Mace Swap
changes.detail: fixed true same-tick attribute swapping (no early Mace pre-swap losing cooldown/damage), upgraded airborne Stun Slam consistency (approach Axe pre-swap + 1-tick dive slam + ShieldBreaker yield), and enforced strict vanilla 3.0 reach with automatic 4.5-block Spear reach

changes.title: Added Pearl Follow to Pearl Grapple (Grapple, Pearl Follow, Both modes + Follow Only On Key / Follow Key) and overhauled airborne & Elytra Mace PvP prediction (feet-anchored 0.6x0.6x0.6 gliding hitbox, pose-accurate self eye height, vanilla pearl tick physics)
Restored classic Auto Anchor (Smart / Classic styles) hardened with ActionCoordinator slot/interact guards, crouch-safe ray checks, and clean packet flushing to prevent flags
Improved Auto Web prediction using smoothed entity velocity, latency/swap lead, and gravity landing snap
Fixed Auto Drain draining your own water/lava in Enemy mode and resolved its conflict with Auto Web Auto Clear Self
Fixed Trigger Bot intermittent non-attacking (rotation-ready & grass/cobweb occlusion checks) and removed Hit Mode while keeping Don't Break Blocks
Fixed Shield Breaker stun follow-up hit to wait properly for swap-back and fire reliably via ActionCoordinator
Improved Aim Assist Smooth mode with a dedicated legit critically-damped easing curve and smooth close-core deceleration
Fixed What's New update modal truncating descriptions by wrapping full multi-line cards cleanly
Renamed Dtap Setup to Auto Hit Crystal
